Part 2

After 5 years of WTF Shoes Wishlist series that I've started. Here is the part 2 of it and will continue for the rest of my days. For this time I try integrated them with social media which comes in 7 slides for IG multiple posts; mimicking interactive sci-fi like in the movies where you scan your thumbprint to access the contents. And still using same method as in part 1 but just different renderer.

For this, I still be using 2D assets and traced it out using shapes and convert the comp into Cinema 4D renderer. Transform from shapes to geometry layer and stack one by one using zSpace to remove the conflict between the geometry. Next, I create the 3D camera to animate it and play around with the animation. The rendering took soo long because of my machine and I add some of the displacement reflection to give it a 3D reflection by only using 2D in After Effects.

- Reebok BB 4500

My first attempt doing IG filter using Spark AR Studio. The filter take place during the COVID19 pandemic and mimicking a face-scanner to identify the vaccines.

Here is the motion graphic for my so-called shoe wish list. I love sneakers that look 80's. I love the vibe, the design and everything else. So, I already have all the shoes. This is what I did in 2017. I experimented with 3D using only 2D assets and playing around with 3D space in After Effects. First, I collect the side view of the shoes on the web and trace them with mask / shape in After Effects. Third, duplicate the 2D layer and stack them one by one in zSpace to make it look like a fake 3D. Next, I create the 3D camera to animate it and play around with the animation. The rendering took soo long, but it's worth it.
